subject: Coord: Matrix Labs trial intake — scheduling + IT/security availability
messages:
From: Ben Foster <ben.foster@matrixlabs.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 2 May 2028 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Quick intro + trial — need AE + SE + IT on call

Hi Neha,

We signed up for the self-serve trial yesterday and I’m Ben (Head of Integrations at Matrix Labs). We’re trying to schedule a walkthrough that includes an AE for product fit and an SE for architecture/security detail. Our CISO wants someone from Redwood to be available to talk about data flows and a couple of firewall rules up front.

High-level:
- Goal: 45–60 minute walkthrough + quick checklist for production sandbox.
- Who from our side: me, Carlos Rojas (IT ops), + our platform engineer Maria Alvarez.
- Constraints: we’re in CET but the platform team is distributed (Madrid / London / NYC).

We can do these windows (all CET):
- Tue 7 May — 10:00–11:30
- Wed 8 May — 08:30–10:00
- Thu 9 May — 14:00–15:30

If you can loop in an SE who knows allowlist and on-prem connector details that would be ideal. Also, we have a short maintenance blackout on Mon nights (CET) that blocks any late EU slots.

Trial id: ML-4871

Thanks,
Ben Foster
Head of Integrations, Matrix Labs
ben.foster@matrixlabs.com
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Foster <ben.foster@matrixlabs.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 2 May 2028 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick intro + trial — need AE + SE + IT on call

Hi Ben — welcome and thanks for signing up. I’m Neha (SDR) and I’ll coordinate the intro. Looping in Jasmine (AE) and Karthik (SE) who will run the session.

Quick plan:
1) Jasmine will own the product walkthrough and customer fit (45 min).
2) Karthik will do a 15-min deep-dive on networking, KV cache persistence, and allowlist needs.
3) I’ll manage the invite and ensure the meeting invite contains the allowlist stub + pre-read.

Before I lock a slot — can you confirm Carlos’s full name/email for the on-call invite? Also, would you prefer a single 60-min meeting or a 45+15 split across the same call? We can compress to 60 if you prefer.

I’ve attached a short checklist (trial-setup-checklist.pdf) and a network allowlist template (network-allowlist.txt) so your IT can pre-check. I’ll propose times matching the windows you suggested; if none fits we can send a 3-option poll.

Links: HubSpot intake: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/contact/ML-4871

Best,
Neha Kapoor
SDR, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Foster <ben.foster@matrixlabs.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 3 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick intro + trial — need AE + SE + IT on call

Thanks Neha / Ben — Jasmine here (AE). Happy to lead the product portion. I’m available in these CET slots:
- Tue 7 May — 10:00–11:00 (good)
- Wed 8 May — 09:00–09:45 (slightly tight but workable)
- Thu 9 May — 14:00–14:45 (good)

Karthik — do you have bandwidth on Tue at 10:45 CET for the 15-min tech deep-dive? If not we can extend the meeting to 75 and split.

Ben — if you prefer, here’s a live booking link (45-min): https://calendly.com/redwood-ae/45-min-demo?month=2028-05

Agenda draft:
- 0–10 min: intros & goals (Ben)
- 10–40 min: product walkthrough (Jasmine)
- 40–55 min: technical deep-dive + allowlist (Karthik)
- 55–60 min: next steps / trial milestones (Neha)

If Matrix needs a longer SE block we’ll accommodate — just let us know which time works best for the full group.

Cheers,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Foster <ben.foster@matrixlabs.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 5 May 2028 08:23:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Quick intro + trial — need AE + SE + IT on call

Jasmine / Neha — thanks for the quick replies. Carlos Rojas is our IT Ops Lead (c.rojas@matrixlabs.com) and he’ll join. Maria (platform eng) will also be present.

Small constraint: we have a planned broadband maintenance on Wed 8 May from 09:30–10:15 CET that knocks out our London office. If we schedule Wed, we need to start before 09:15 or after 10:30.

Given that, the best options for us are:
- Tue 7 May 10:00–11:15 CET (preferred)
- Thu 9 May 14:00–15:15 CET (ok)

We’d prefer a single 75-min slot so Karthik has enough time for the deep-dive and to review our allowlist changes. If possible, please include a brief run-through of certificate management and a note on persistent KV store TTLs for our platform eng.

Appreciate the attachments — Carlos will review the allowlist.

On a related note, is there a Zoom bridge or private dial-in you prefer? We have a corporate dial-in that sometimes blocks third-party meeting links.

Ben
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>

- Title: Matrix Labs — Redwood trial walkthrough + security deep-dive
- When: Tue 7 May 2028, 10:00–11:15 CET (please confirm immediately if this now conflicts)
- Bridge: Zoom (Redwood-provided). If your corp dial-in has restrictions, Carlos please advise and we’ll include a dial-in fallback.
- Agenda (final):
  0–10 min: Intros & goals — Ben / Matrix
 10–45 min: Product walkthrough — Jasmine (AE)

Pre-reads / attachments: trial-setup-checklist.pdf, network-allowlist.txt, demo-agenda-v1.md (attached). Please ask Carlos to pre-send any network ACLs or proxy details that could affect connectivity.

Action items:

- Maria: share the internal test endpoint or sample payloads if you want us to verify during the demo.
